items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Was Gertrude Bernstein and her brother was the bass player, Artie Bernstein, with Benny's band.

ctx.x: Was Gertrude Bernstein and her brother was the bass player, Artie Bernstein, with Benny's band. And she came down to Atlantic City and I remember thinking, she's one beautiful girl.

Now, I had never seen many Jewish girls and I thought she was really an unusual kind of beauty. I thought she was the most beautiful woman I ever saw, you know. After seeing those washed-out blonds, you know. And this was a real thing. But I never did anything about it, you know. I had another girlfriend.
